title: SendCutSend-ready sheet metal: merged DXF, bend relief
summary: Flat patterns export as a merged single-silhouette DXF with dashed bend centerlines, bends get parametric relief notches, and the sendcutsend shop profile locks radii/K to SCS tooling.
details: sheet_metal_unfold now emits a fab-ready merged DXF: one closed exterior polyline plus holes on CUT and DASHED bend centerlines on the allowance midline. New bend_relief option cuts relief notches at bend ends (3D, flat, and DXF). shop_profile: "sendcutsend" resolves every bend's radius and K-factor from SCS's published bending calculator — custom radii are rejected, omitted radii resolve automatically — and sheet_metal_bend_table can return the full catalog. For zero data entry, export the folded body as STEP via export_cad and let the shop auto-detect bends.
